hazards.description: The sidewalk is directly adjacent to the roadway with no buffer zone, placing pedestrians in close proximity to parked and moving vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curb line in the foreground

hazards.name: Narrow obstructed sidewalk
hazards.description: Utility poles and narrow width restrict pedestrian movement and accessibility.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the street

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions
hazards.description: Parked vehicles and the proximity of buildings to the street edge create blind spots for pedestrians entering the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the left curb and building corners

hazards.name: Uneven and Cracked Pavement
hazards.description: The sidewalk surface is significantly degraded with cracks and uneven sections, creating a trip hazard.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and midground walkway area.

hazards.name: Walkway Obstructions
hazards.description: Trash cans and a folding chair are placed directly in the path of travel, further narrowing the already limited walking space.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image on the sidewalk.

hazards.name: Uneven Pavement
hazards.description: The sidewalk surface is cracked and uneven, creating a significant tripping hazard for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and midground sidewalk area

hazards.name: Narrow walkway
hazards.description: The sidewalk width is restricted by the building steps and the proximity of parked cars, making it difficult for pedestrians to pass comfortably.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the building frontage behind the parked car

hazards.name: Visual obstruction from parked vehicles
hazards.description: The large vehicle in the foreground blocks sightlines between the sidewalk and the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground, curb side of the sidewalk

hazards.name: Narrow Sidewalks
hazards.description: The sidewalks are narrow and further constrained by private encroachments like fences and planters, limiting pedestrian mobility.
hazards.location_in_image: Both sides of the street, particularly the right foreground.

hazards.name: Narrow Pedestrian Path
hazards.description: The existing sidewalk is very narrow and further constrained by building steps, leaving little room for pedestrians to pass each other or stay clear of the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Both sides of the street, immediately adjacent to the buildings.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The zebra markings for the crosswalk are significantly worn, reducing visibility for approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground roadway

hazards.name: Sidewalk Debris and Litter
hazards.description: Accumulated trash and debris on the sidewalk create tripping hazards and reduce usable width.
hazards.location_in_image: Right and left sidewalks

hazards.name: Blank Frontage
hazards.description: The large expanse of windowless brick wall reduces passive surveillance ('eyes on the street'), which can impact perceived personal safety.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image, building facade

hazards.name: Substandard Sidewalk Width
hazards.description: The sidewalks on both sides of the street are extremely narrow, likely less than 3 feet wide, making it impossible for two people to pass or for a wheelchair user to navigate.
hazards.location_in_image: Both sides of the street adjacent to the buildings

hazards.name: Pedestrian-Vehicle Conflict
hazards.description: Due to the narrow sidewalks and parked cars, pedestrians are forced to walk in the travel lane, increasing the risk of conflict with moving vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the roadway

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct a raised, paved sidewalk to provide physical separation between pedestrians and motor vehicles.

interventions.title: Shared Street (Woonerf) Treatment
interventions.description: If the right-of-way is too narrow for a standard sidewalk, use paving textures and traffic calming to create a low-speed shared environment where pedestrians have priority.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lighting to ensure pedestrians are visible to drivers, especially given the narrow geometry.

interventions.title: Regular Maintenance and Cleaning
interventions.description: Implement regular street sweeping and litter removal to maintain a clear and safe walking surface.

interventions.title: Designated Trash Storage
interventions.description: Provide designated areas for waste receptacles that do not encroach on the pedestrian clear zone.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening
interventions.description: Reallocate street space to widen the sidewalks, providing a safer and more accessible path for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Shared Street Design
interventions.description: Convert the street into a shared street (woonerf) where pedestrians have priority and vehicle speeds are naturally slowed by design elements.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces near intersections or potential crossing points to improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Street Trees or Planters
interventions.description: Introduce vegetation to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the narrow sidewalk and the roadway.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Installing curb extensions at the ends of the block would improve visibility and shorten crossing distances.

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Adding street trees in a furniture zone would provide a physical and psychological buffer between pedestrians and the roadway.

interventions.title: Clear Path Maintenance
interventions.description: Enforce regulations to keep sidewalks clear of trash and private property to ensure a minimum clear walking width.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Lighting
interventions.description: Install street-level lighting to enhance visibility and safety for pedestrians during evening hours.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Clearance
interventions.description: Enforce regulations to keep sidewalks clear of trash bins and construction debris to maintain a continuous walking path.

interventions.title: Street Lighting
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility and safety during night hours.

interventions.title: Parking Enforcement and Physical Barriers
interventions.description: Install bollards or a raised curb to prevent vehicles from parking on the sidewalk and blocking pedestrian access.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair
interventions.description: Resurface the walkway to provide a smooth, ADA-compliant path for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer Zone
interventions.description: Introduce a planting strip or furniture zone between the sidewalk and the curb to provide physical and psychological separation from traffic.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair and Leveling
interventions.description: Repave the sidewalk to provide a smooth, ADA-compliant surface free of trip hazards.

interventions.title: Curbside Management and Buffering
interventions.description: Introduce a designated furniture zone or planting strip with street trees to separate the walking path from the street and organize utilities/trash.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Mark crossings at intersections with high-visibility paint to clearly define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Enhanced Maintenance
interventions.description: Implement regular street cleaning to remove litter and debris from the pedestrian path.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planters
interventions.description: Introduce street trees or large planters to provide a physical buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway while improving the microclimate.

interventions.title: Speed Humps
interventions.description: Install speed humps to ensure vehicle speeds remain low on this narrow residential corridor.

interventions.title: Bicycle Parking
interventions.description: Install designated bike racks to provide a secure place for bicycle storage that does not obstruct the pedestrian through-zone.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Install speed humps or other vertical deflection measures to ensure vehicle speeds remain low in this residential context.

interventions.title: Street Trees or Furniture Zone
interventions.description: Add a buffer between the sidewalk and the parking lane to enhance safety and the pedestrian experience.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Vegetation
interventions.description: Adding street trees would provide a physical buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway while also serving as a natural traffic calming measure.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Maintenance
interventions.description: Leveling or replacing uneven concrete slabs to ensure a smooth, accessible walking surface.

interventions.title: Trash Management Policy
interventions.description: Implementing guidelines for the placement of waste receptacles to ensure they do not block the pedestrian clear zone.

interventions.title: Clear Path Enforcement
interventions.description: Enforce regulations to keep sidewalks clear of private property like basketball hoops and large covered items to maintain a continuous pedestrian path.

interventions.title: Shared Street (Woonerf) Conversion
interventions.description: Redesign the street as a shared space where pedestrians have priority, using textured paving and removing the traditional curb to slow vehicles.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Clearance Enforcement
interventions.description: Implement and enforce local ordinances to keep the public right-of-way clear of large private obstructions.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planting Strips
interventions.description: Add a furniture or planting zone between the sidewalk and the curb to provide a buffer and organize street elements.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at the corners to shorten crossing distances and prevent parking too close to the intersection, improving sightlines.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair and Maintenance
interventions.description: Repair cracked pavement and implement regular cleaning to remove debris and improve accessibility.

interventions.title: Parking Removal and Sidewalk Widening
interventions.description: Remove parking on one side of the street to allow for the widening of at least one sidewalk to meet ADA accessibility standards.
